title: Central Government Must Notify Locations In Official Gazette

content.scenario: The Central Government is planning to notify locations in the Official Gazette. The Central Government must notify these locations to ensure that the National Commission can function at the National Capital Region and other places as specified in the rules.
content.outcome: The Central Government must notify locations in the Official Gazette.

keywords: notification of locations in Official Gazette
user_queries: What is the Central Government's obligation regarding notification of locations in the Official Gazette?
How does the Central Government notify locations in the Official Gazette?
What is the purpose of the notification?
